card.title: Take My Side
card.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're Alex's friend too. Tell him alternating weekends at the allotment was a fair compromise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We agreed all three of us would go every Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help him see my version as sharing the workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll talk to him, but you have to admit you changed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I will. Could you explain that I changed the rota because I want us to stay friends?

mechanism: A asks a mutual friend to present a changed allotment plan as fair workload sharing and friendship preservation.
confusable: Unlike private justification, A must recruit a bridge to the shared person in the conflict.
comparison: D79-b accepts factual admission while seeking a favorable motive explanation; D79-a accepts full facts but seeks helpful-first framing.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
